decisions.reason: As a 2023 product line with several models that builds on the firm’s established laser-marking business, it reflects meaningful investment and is still being carried on the website, so management would be inclined to continue rather than admit a mistaken launch.

This printer is close to the core offer, has had its own product page across two years, and sits well with the firm’s customized coding solutions, making continued commitment more likely than withdrawal.

Because it is a close extension of the firm’s existing coding technologies and remains publicly presented on its own page, management is likely to persist and interpret any weaker uptake as temporary rather than exit quickly.

As a 2024 flagship product line shown on the home page and tied to the firm’s stated strategic direction toward more digitalized identification and traceability, it carries the strongest public and strategic commitment and is therefore very unlikely to be dropped soon.

The newly launched laser cabin is a visible extension of the established laser offer and has been explicitly promoted as new, so the firm has both invested in it and publicly backed it, which favors keeping it on the market.

Although this is a more specialized application and appears less prominently than some others, it still builds on the firm’s marking expertise and has external validation through a trade-fair award, which supports continued commitment rather than discontinuation.
